text: 中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅23日上午在马尼拉会见埃及外长阿卜杜勒阿提。王毅表示，中方愿同埃方一道，密切高层交往，深化经贸、军事、人工智能等领域合作，加强多边事务协作，共同构建面向新时代的中埃命运共同体。在埃方支持下，米娜宫饭店建立《开罗宣言》纪念碑，具有重要纪念意义，也体现了埃方尊重历史、弘扬正义、重视对华关系的积极态度。（新华社）
text_en: Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, met with Egyptian Foreign Minister Abdel Aty in Manila on the morning of the 23rd. Wang Yi said that China is willing to work with Egypt to maintain close high-level exchanges, deepen cooperation in trade, military, artificial intelligence, and other fields, strengthen multilateral coordination, and jointly build a China-Egypt community with a shared future for the new era. With Egyptian support, the establishment of the 'Cairo Declaration' monument at the Mena House Hotel holds significant commemorative value and reflects Egypt's respect for history, promotion of justice, and positive attitude toward China relations. (Xinhua News Agency)
